Evaluate a single user-supplied PubMed query against enriched seeds

Source: R/06_optimizer.R
evaluate_custom_query.Rd

Evaluate a single user-supplied PubMed query against enriched seeds

Usage

evaluate_custom_query(
  pm_query,
  seeds_df,
  label = "Custom",
  gs_query = NULL,
  email = NULL,
  ncbi_key = NULL,
  cache_dir = ".cache",
  use_cache = TRUE,
  eval_pubmed_fn = pubmed_eval_query
)

Arguments

pm_query

Raw PubMed query string.

seeds_df

Enriched seeds tibble.

label

Display label for the custom query.

gs_query

Optional Google Scholar query string (auto-approximated if NULL/blank).

email

Optional email for NCBI polite pool.

ncbi_key

Optional NCBI API key.

cache_dir

Cache directory path.

use_cache

Logical; whether to read/write cache.

eval_pubmed_fn

Function `(pm_query, seed_pmids, ...)` returning `pm_hits`, `pm_found`, `pm_recall`, `ok`.

Value

1-row tibble matching `eval_df` schema.
